title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: STEERING:YOKE (MOTORCYCLE) (18,672 affected)
summary: SOME UNIVERSAL JOINT YOKES WERE FORGED WITH INCORRECT STEEL, RESULTING IN BRITTLE WELDS BETWEEN THE YOKE AND ITS MATING SHAFT. FIELD SERVICE LOADS MAY CAUSE FAILURE OF THE WELD AND CAUSE THE YOKE TO SEPARATE FROM ITS SHAFT.

title: DE LOREAN MOTOR COMPANY: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:ELECTRICAL (5,342 affected)
summary: AN INERTIA SWITCH DESIGNED TO CUT OFF THE FUEL PUMP DURING ACCIDENTAL IMPACT MAY NOT OPERATE PROPERLY.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:LPG LINES:FITTINGS SYSTEMS (116 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE SUSPECT VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH IMPROPERLY TIGHTENED PROPANE FUEL SYSTEM FITTINGS IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT; FUEL LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR.

title: TRIDON, INCORPORATED: LIGHTING:GENERAL COMPONENT:EMERGENCY FLASHING HAZA (12,974 affected)
summary: THESE ELECTRONIC SIGNAL FLASHERS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT". WHEN SUBJECTED TO A TEMPERATURE OF ZERO DEGREES FAHRENHEIT, THE FLASH RATE OF THESE UNITS MAY NOT STAY WITHIN AN ACCEPTABLE RANGE.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FUEL:LPG LINES:(PIPES) METALLIC (30 affected)
summary: THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT ON CERTAIN VEHICLES THE L.P. GAS TUBING MAY BE DAMAGED OR CRACKED BY THE AXLE WHEN THE AXLE IS SUBJECTED TO EXTREME UPWARD MOVEMENT. DAMAGE TO THE L.P. GAS TUBING COULD CAUSE GAS LEAKAGE.

title: Ford Motor Company: EXHAUST SYSTEM:MUFFLER:RESONATOR (24 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE MUFFLER GRASS SHIELDS WERE INADVERTENTLY OMITTED DURING MANUFACTURE. WITHOUT THE GRASS SHIELD, AND DURING CERTAIN OPERATING CONDITIONS, THE MUFFLER SURFACE TEMPERATURES COULD BECOME HOT ENOUGH TO EXCEED SPECIFIED STANDARDS AND CREATE THE POTENTIAL FOR IGNITING TALL GRASSES IF THEY WERE PRESENT BENEATH A STANDING VEHICLE.

title: ATLAS COPCO N.A., INC: TIRES (998 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THESE TIRES MAY HAVE BELOW MINIMUM TIRE CARCASS STRENGTH AND MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO IMPACT DAMAGE, PARTICULARLY WHEN RUN OVERINFLATED OR OVERLOADED.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID (40 affected)
summary: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE FOR THE LCF THROTTLE ROD BELL CRANK TO MAKE CONTACT WITH THE RADIATOR SEAL. THIS CAN RESULT IN REDUCED ENGINE PERFORMANCE AND/OR THROTTLE RETURN.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: STEERING:WHEEL:HANDLEBAR (43,300 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL NUT MAY HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED INSUFFICIENTLY DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS AND MAY LOOSEN AND DEVELOP PLAY BETWEEN THE STEERING WHEEL AND THE STEERING SHAFT. THE STEERING WHEEL COULD SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING SHAFT.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (18,082 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS", DUE TO THE BRAKE PEDAL HEIGHT BEING ADJUSTED LOWER THAN SPECIFICATIONS. IF A VEHICLE HAS SUCH A MISADJUSTMENT IT COULD ALSO EXPERIENCE PARTIAL BRAKE SYSTEM DISABLEMENT.

title: DANA CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:FITTINGS:METALLIC (1,300 affected)
summary: REUSABLE AIR BRAKE END FITTINGS FOR AIR BRAKE HOSE FAILS TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 106, "BRAKE HOSES". THE REUSABLE FITTINGS ARE INCORRECTLY MARKED "AII" INSTEAD OF "AI".

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL (92,000 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, AN IMPROPERLY PLACED MAT INTERFERES WITH THE VIBRATION ABSORBER ATTACHED TO THE UNDERSIDE OF THE ACCELERATOR. THE PEDAL MAY NOT FULLY RETURN TO THE IDLE POSITION.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (393 affected)
summary: DURING A PISTON PIN MANUFACTURING PROCESS, CRACKS HAVE OCCURRED IN THE INNER SURFACE OF THE PIN. THESE CRACKS COULD LEAD TO COMPLETE BREAKAGE OF THE PIN, WHICH IN TURN COULD RESULT IN ENGINE FAILURE AND POSSIBLE SUDDEN ENGINE SEIZURE.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (331 affected)
INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:PLATE:DRIVE:CLUTCH (11,130 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES THE CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE MAY SUDDENLY SELF DESTRUCT, SCATTERING BROKEN FRAGMENTS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (15,988 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH AN INADEQUATE SEAL BETWEEN THE FUEL FILLER PIPE-HOUSING ASSEMBLY AND THE FUEL FILLER OPENING-COLLAR ASSEMBLY. TWO ATTACHING SCREWS AT THE BOTTOM OF THIS JOINT WERE OMITTED DURING ASSEMBLY. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT A SMALL QUANTITY OF OVERFLOW FUEL COULD LEAK INTO THE RIGHT REAR FENDER WELL BEHIND THE LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT TRIM PANEL IF FUEL "SPIT-BACK" OR OVERFILLING WERE TO OCCUR DURING REFUELING.

title: BROUGHAM INDUSTRIES, INC.: FUEL:LPG LINES:(PIPES) METALLIC (24 affected)
summary: ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES, THE IMPROPER ROUTING OF THE L.P. GAS PIPING BETWEEN THE L.P. GAS TANK AND THE FUEL BURNING APPLIANCE MIGHT CAUSE THE REAR AXLE SUSPENSION SYSTEM TO DAMAGE THE PIPING. THE PIPING MAY RUPTURE AND ALLOW THE L.P. GAS TO LEAK.
